user.title: Set up Daybook
user.description: Daybook keeps a private journal of meds, caffeine, how you feel and sport in a local database. After setup, open Daybook in the sidebar to add your meds and drinks.

unknown_item.message: There's no {kind} called "{item}" in Daybook settings.

bad_med_status.message: A med entry must be taken or skipped.

unknown_entry.message: There's no Daybook entry with id {id}.

item.name: Item
item.description: Id of the state, drink or med from Daybook settings, or the sport activity.

when.name: When
when.description: When it happened. Defaults to now.

offset_minutes.name: Offset
offset_minutes.description: Shift the time, for example -30 for half an hour ago.

end.name: End
end.description: End time, for sport and sleep.

skipped.name: Skipped
skipped.description: Records a med as deliberately not taken.

source.name: Source
source.description: Where the entry came from, used by undo last.

id.name: Id
id.description: Entry id, returned by the log action.

delete.name: Delete
delete.description: Deletes an entry. It can be restored from the panel.

undo_last.name: Undo last
undo_last.description: Deletes the most recent entry, for example on a long press.

source.name: Source
source.description: Only undo entries from this source.

within_minutes.name: Within
within_minutes.description: Only undo entries created this recently.
